title: Uru Vegan Bake
description: A hearty Uruguayan-inspired vegan bake filled with aromatic spices and pillowy rice. Perfect for a comforting snack or light lunch.

ingredients.name: bake
ingredients.notes: unsweetened bake mix or oat flour

instructions: Cut the Uruguayan flatbread into bite-sized pieces.
In a large bowl, mix together cooked rice, uncooked rice, unsweetened bake mix or oat flour, and dried oregano or thyme.
Add the baked pieces to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
